title: Nylas grant.expired notification object
description: Sent when a grant's credentials expire, typically due to a change in the user's password on the provider, OAuth token expiration without successful refresh, the provider revoking access, or an admin revoking app permissions. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

grant_id.description: Unique identifier for the expired grant.

integration_id.description: Identifier for the connector (integration) associated with this grant.

email.description: Email address associated with the expired grant.

grant_updated_at.description: Unix timestamp of the last successful grant update before expiration.
